task_units: BBH 27 subtasks plus GSM8K as one task
episode_unit: question IDs; same generation seed support/query; three seeds are repeated measurements
seen_mode: same task first half history, remaining pool split support/query
unseen_mode: entire target task excluded from base history
full_feedback: all 20 existing aggregate scores for support question at that generation seed
restricted_feedback: only default combination score; unknown actions remain unobserved
random_control: shuffle observed support rewards within action, support IDs fixed
